answer: A payout is split so that 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The whisper schedule is applied in plume and tundra exposes each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2187 identities would post 3137 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
